name: חיבור שברים אלגבריים – גורם (u+v) ומכנים שונים (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Express the following as a single fraction in it's lowest terms: \[\frac{{CT:0}}{{CT:1}}+\frac{{CT:2}}{{CT:3}}. \]
[[input:ans]] [[validation:ans]]
generalfeedback:
You can treat compound terms, \({{CT:4}}\) as a single variable when simplifying the above expression. Alternatively you can substitute \(u = {{CT:4}}\) and thereby simplify with a single variable:
\[\frac{{CT:0}}{{CT:1}}+\frac{{CT:2}}{{CT:3}} = \frac{{{CT:5}}u}{{CT:1}}+\frac{{{CT:6}}u}{{CT:3}} = \frac{{{CT:7}}u}{{CT:8}}+\frac{{{CT:9}}u}{{CT:8}} = \frac{{{CT:10}}u}{{CT:8}} = {{CT:11}}. \]

on_true.feedback: You cannot simply add the numerators and denominators when adding fractions. You need to find a common denominator and then add the fractions. One option is to use the general rule: \(\frac{a}{c}+\frac{b}{d} = \frac{ad+cd}{cd} \)
